nested-case.specification:
yamaa: "1.0"
type: spec
domain: TEST
keys: [ID]
input: {SRC: input.csv}
output: {path: output.csv, columns: [ID, TEXT]}
columns:
  - {name: ID, type: str, derivation: SRC.ID}
  - name: TEXT
    type: str
    derivation:
      case:
        - when: "ID = 'row1'"
          then:
            case:
              - when: "ID = 'row1'"
                then: {str_pad: {source: SRC.TEXT, width: 4}}
              - otherwise: {str_case: {source: SRC.TEXT, to: upper}}
        - otherwise: "'safe'"
